faq.a: Ocean container (FCL/LCL), RORO, air freight, road transport, customs service (T1/NCTS, EUR.1, ATR, PLDA), logistics & warehousing, parcels & express. Traveller ticketing: flights and long-distance coach tickets. Approved DHL drop-off point.

faq.q: How much does a 40' to Antwerp cost?
faq.a: It depends on the port of departure, the goods and the incoterm. A Louhichi advisor confirms the final rate within 1 business hour, excluding customs duties & VAT.

faq.q: What documents do I need for an export?
faq.a: Commercial invoice, packing list, HS code, and depending on the destination: EUR.1, ATR, certificate of origin. We assist you with incoterms and cargo insurance.
